name: Exterior Foundation Surface Preparation
intent: Masonry-specific prep: moisture test, form-release removal (poured), efflorescence treatment, pressure wash, crack patch, bug hole patch (poured), surface profile verification.
doctrine: Masonry-specific prep for foundation. MC <= 4% hard stop (stricter than masonry wall 12% due to ground contact). Form-release removal on poured concrete only. Pressure wash at 1500-2500 PSI (pressure wash IS valid on masonry, unlike siding). Bug holes are poured concrete only. Surface profile only when too smooth for primer adhesion. Foundation type modifier (CMU=1.15x) applies to wash.
